_about: Maps every entry on the ABA's alphabetical list of Council-approved law schools to the row(s) in schools.json that cover it. audit.py uses this to catch missing schools. When the ABA adds, closes or renames a school, update this file, abaListCount and retrieved together. Two ABA entries map to two rows each (one per campus): Rutgers and Penn State-Dickinson Law.
abaListNote: 198 schools conferring the J.D., plus the U.S. Army Judge Advocate General's School (LL.M. only)
